free_tier_limits.correction: New accounts get free credits (Baseten materials cite $30); Basic plan is $0/mo pay-as-you-go. Model API defaults: Basic unverified 15 RPM / 100k TPM; Basic verified 120 RPM / 500k TPM.

rate_limits.correction: Published. Model APIs: Basic unverified 15 RPM / 100k TPM; Basic verified 120 RPM / 500k TPM; Pro 120 RPM / 1M TPM; Enterprise custom. Management API has per-key limits (e.g. 20/min on activate endpoints).

cors.correction: Dedicated deployment endpoints do not include CORS response headers; browser-based calls may be blocked (server-side calls recommended).

example.correction: curl -X POST https://model-YOUR_MODEL_ID.api.baseten.co/environments/production/predict -H "Authorization: Bearer $BASETEN_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt": "Hello, world!"}' (or Model APIs: https://inference.baseten.co/v1/chat/completions). Bare POST to https://api.baseten.co/ is not a valid inference call.

notes: API is live. Failures: rate_limits are published (not "not published"); example path/host is wrong; CORS is documented as absent on dedicated endpoints; free_tier_limits are knowable (credits + tier RPM/TPM).
